title: A home for what's new
body:
You're reading it. PolTok now has an **Updates** page with every release in one place.

- Filter by **New**, **Improved**, **Fixed** or **Data**, or search
- A small dot next to the settings gear tells you when something new has shipped since your last visit
- Prefer a reader? Subscribe to the [RSS feed](/api/updates.rss)

title: Better-looking share cards and Australian MP portraits
body:
Share cards got a full design overhaul: 20 premium templates, procedurally drawn backgrounds, a proper type system, and map and chart artwork. Some cards can now animate.

Australian people pages now show **236 freely licensed portraits** from Wikimedia Commons, each with its credit. Where no free photo exists you'll see initials instead.

- Head-to-head cards no longer overlap their call-to-action
- Text stays readable on light palettes and fills

title: Australia deep dive: states, history and a polling average
body:
The Australia section went much deeper:

- **States & territories** — all 8 parliaments, with sources and as-of dates (we double-checked NT, the Tasmanian Legislative Council and the ACT)
- **History** — federal elections and prime ministers
- **Polling average** — weighted two-party-preferred and primaries
- **Victorian districts** — all 88 seats with 2022 results
- Seat pages now include census profiles

title: Accessibility pass across every theme
body:
We went through the site looking for things that made it harder to read or navigate:

- Text contrast fixed across all themes
- Images sized correctly so pages don't jump
- Links are underlined where colour alone wasn't enough
- Every page now has a proper title

title: Candidate profiles with verified sources
body: Candidate pages now pull verified profiles from **Wikipedia and Wikidata**: career history, ideology, and photos — always with credit to the photographer and licence.

title: Calendar, campaign money, your area, members and 2028
body:
A big batch of new pages:

- **Elections calendar** — US and Australian dates, with an ICS feed you can add to your own calendar
- **Money** — campaign finance from OpenFEC, plus a money box on race pages
- **Your area** — look up your representatives and races by US address/ZIP or Australian postcode
- **Members** — a directory and profiles for lawmakers
- **2028** — presidential race odds and the path to 270

title: Smarter Ask PolTok and Australian bills
body:
**Ask PolTok** now looks up live data on the server and draws on a built-in knowledge base before answering, shows live cards inline, and has a redesigned chat.

The Parliament tracker now covers **bills before the Australian Parliament**, via a public mirror updated on weekdays plus the Federal Register of Legislation.

title: Main menu, three new themes and Senate votes
body:
- New **Main Menu** hub that gathers every page in one place
- Three new looks in Settings: **Paper**, **Terminal** and **Aurora**
- Senate roll-call votes via Voteview, and House counts are now consistent everywhere
- Fixed a crash that showed a blank screen in current Chrome
- Fixed several Ask PolTok errors ("Request too large", retired model 404s)

title: Ask PolTok, share cards and embeddable widgets
body:
- **Ask PolTok** — ask questions in plain English, answered from PolTok's live data
- **Share cards** — turn a race or seat into an image for social media, from race and AU seat pages
- **Embed widgets** — put live PolTok widgets on your own site
- **Parliament tracker** for live bills
- Australia grew: Senate, parties, NSW, a swingometer and Victorian candidates

title: Install PolTok, search everything
body:
- PolTok is now an **installable app** (PWA) on phone and desktop
- A post-election home page
- **Global search** — press `Ctrl+K` or `/` anywhere
- New **Governors** and **Candidates** pages

title: Flips, ballot measures, watchlist and replay
body:
- **Flips** — seats that changed hands
- **Ballot measures** — statewide measures, live
- **Watchlist** — star races and get alerts
- **Compare** — races side by side, including the polling miss
- **Replay** and **Analysis** — relive election night and dig into the trends

Secondary pages now live under a **More** menu so the top bar stays tidy.

title: Australia arrives
body:
A whole new Australia section:

- **Electorate maps** for federal seats and Victoria, in geographic or hex view, with metro zoom
- An **/au** hub, a **Victoria election night** page and individual seat pages
- Australian news, markets and results data

title: Live-first: real market odds, Settings and county maps
body:
- Real **Polymarket** odds
- **Settings**: pick your time zone (including Melbourne), race-call alerts and sound
- A race-call animation and **county-level maps**
- The forecast now updates as results come in
- New **Broadcast** cable-news theme

title: Real AP results, with a Live/Simulated switch
body:
PolTok can now show **real AP results (via The New York Times)**. A toggle lets you switch between Live and the simulated demo replay, and every simulated surface is clearly labelled.

If our news server is unreachable, your browser now fetches headlines directly as a fallback.

title: Polls, a forecast lab, race and state pages
body:
- 2026 midterm data: states, 140 races and real poll series
- **Polls** page with weighted averages
- **Forecast lab** running Monte Carlo simulations
- A page for every race and every state

title: PolTok launches
body:
The first version of PolTok: an election-night command center.

- A home dashboard and the dark "command center" design
- **Interactive electoral maps** that morph between geographic and hex views, in 6 modes, plus build-your-own
- A live election-night control room
- Aggregated news from real RSS feeds, with bias labels
- A TikTok-style vertical **feed**
